snippet.title: BlazBlue Entropy Effect - New DLC Bullet is coming on June 26th!
snippet.description:
BBEE's new DLC - Bullet Character Pack is coming on June 26th (PT), sync with Steam Summer Sales! The DLC will be priced at $4.99, with a 25% launch discount.

Wishlist Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681910/BlazBlue_Entropy_Effect__Bullet_Character_Pack/

With her iconic gauntlet Smash Hail, specializing in strike-and-throw attacks, Bullet can grab enemies from various angles, then fire off follow-up attacks in rapid succession. 

This DLC will also bring a set of Prototype Palettes applicable to Mai, Bullet, Es, and Taokaka as well as an exclusive Avatar.
